title: ignite/config.json
description: Field reference for .rbtv/config/ignite/config.json. Ignite config.js validates the record directly and does not load this schema; its validator is authoritative. Authoring guidance is in core/ignite/capabilities/glossary/ignite-config.md.

slack.description: The Slack workspace Ignite connects to.

botUserId.description: The Slack user id of Ignite's bot.

ownerUserId.description: The Slack user id of the one person the agents answer.

appTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the app-level token that opens the connection.

botTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the bot token that posts replies.

ownerTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the owner's user token.

stoolsWorkspace.description: Slack command-line workspace name, not a path; Ignite also rejects absolute paths on the current platform.

tools.description: The commands Ignite runs, as their names on PATH.

cast.description: The command that runs each agent turn.

audio.description: The command that transcribes and speaks audio.

dmAgent.description: The agent that receives the owner's direct messages. Absent when no agent does.

routes.description: Channel id to agent slug. Channel ids must contain a non-whitespace character; config.js checks each key.

payments.description: Turns the payment gate's service side on: the owner's /payments panel and buttons, sending approved payments, and the withdrawal validation listener on 127.0.0.1. Absent: payment requests are refused. Settings, limits and the PIN are not here; the owner sets them in /payments.

webhookPort.description: The local port of the withdrawal validation listener. 8787 when absent.

webhookTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the token the bank sends with each withdrawal validation (Asaas: the asaas-access-token header). ASAAS_WEBHOOK_TOKEN when absent.
